title: Stretch and Shrink

serves.summary: The learner stretches or shrinks copies of a ribbon by fraction factors (×3/4, ×5/4, ×1, ×1 1/3) on a number line, and with the numbers removed places each copy by reasoning that a factor above 1 makes it longer, below 1 shorter, and 1 the same, which shows multiplication as scaling.

request.objective: Interpret multiplication as scaling: compare the size of a product to the size of one factor based on the other factor, without multiplying (a factor greater than 1 gives a bigger product, less than 1 a smaller one, equal to 1 the same) (5.NF.B.5).

problems.ask: The yarn ribbon is 8 long. Make a copy of it for each card: ×3/4 and ×3/2.
problems.goal: The ×3/4 copy ends at 6 and the ×3/2 copy ends at 12.
